name: Clinical Trials & Research Matching Agent
description: Clinical Trials & Research Matching Agent — a governed Pause fabric agent (agentforce, A2A). Governance tier: care-coordination. Enforces 4 Pause Agent Fabric policies. Prototype agent card — synthetic data, no real PHI.

skills.name: Matches a SINGLE menopause/midlife patient against a synt...
skills.description: Matches a SINGLE menopause/midlife patient against a synthetic research-study catalog using STRUCTURED eligibility criteria (age band, symptom profile, comorbidities, geography, prior therapy, HRT status, postmenopausal status) — the 'Agentforce for Health' clinical-trials / research-matching analog, distinct from the population-health, care-gap, remote-monitoring, referral, and education agents

skills.name: Eligibility matching is DETERMINISTIC — a pure function o...
skills.description: Eligibility matching is DETERMINISTIC — a pure function of the patient context against each study's DEFINED criteria (no randomness, no clock); the same context always yields the same matches + ranking with a stable, documented tie-break (eligible first, then match score, then studyId)

skills.name: Every eligibility determination traces to a defined study...
skills.description: Every eligibility determination traces to a defined study criterion — a fabricated / ad-hoc / off-catalog eligibility is blocked at the Agent Fabric governance boundary (policy.trials.eligibility-criteria-sourced)

skills.name: Trial outreach is RESEARCH-CONSENT-GATED — it defers to t...
skills.description: Trial outreach is RESEARCH-CONSENT-GATED — it defers to the patient's `research` consent scope (the Consent & Preferences Management agent's, withheld by default) and drafts an active outreach only when research consent is present, otherwise it withholds outreach (policy.trials.research-consent-required); and it NEVER enrolls a patient autonomously — enrollment requires informed consent + a human (policy.trials.no-autonomous-enrollment)

skills.name: Runs against an ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic study catalog — st...
skills.description: Runs against an ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic study catalog — studies, sponsors, criteria, and patient references clearly labeled; NOT real studies, real sponsors, or a certified trial-eligibility engine
